zh: 茂密的树木，可改造为伐木场,伐木场会根据周围的森林地块数量生产木头资源。
en: Dense woods. Can be UPGRADE to a Logging Camp, which produces Wood based on the number of adjacent Forest tiles.

zh: 广袤的平原，可以改造成麦田地块，可以使相邻的磨坊地块生产食物资源。
en: Vast plains. Can be UPGRADE into a Wheat Field to boost the Food production of adjacent Mills.

zh: 一片山脉,可以被改造成采石场，采石场需要与道路相邻以产生石头资源。
en: Rugged mountains. Can be GPGRADE to a Quarry. The Quarry must be adjacent to a Road to produce Stone.

zh: 周围每有一个麦田地块，食物产量+{adj_food}
en: Grants +{adj_food} Food for each adjacent Wheat.

zh: 道路用来连接整个物流系统，生产建筑必须与道路相邻才能工作，道路放置时需要花费额外石头，花费量与距离总部的距离有关。
en: The backbone of your logistics network. Production buildings must be adjacent to a Road to function. Building Roads costs extra Stone based on the distance from your Headquarters.

zh: 每回合自动产生探险家，可用于抽取自然地块
en: Explorers are automatically generated each round and can be used to extract natural tiles.
A Market. Increases your Max Trade Points by +1 for each adjacent Coast tile.

zh: 一座市场，相邻每有一个海岸地块，贸易点数上限+1。
en: A market will increase the number of trading points based on the number of surrounding coast tile.

zh: 一座精炼炉，每回合消耗{wood_maintance}木头和{stone_maintance}石头生产{metal_production}金属。
en: A Furnace. Consumes {wood_maintance} Wood and {stone_maintance} Stone to produce {metal_production} Metal per turn.

zh: 每一座麦田地块可以使相邻的磨坊食物产量+2
en: A Wheat Field. Grants +2 Food production to all adjacent Mills.

zh: 采石场每回合会产生{stone_production}石头
en: A Quarry. Produces {stone_production} Stone per turn.

zh: 化为废墟的采石场，会使周围的道路无法工作，可以通过改造复原。
en: A Ruined Quarry. Disables adjacent Roads. Can be restored through the upgrade menu.

zh: 道路用来连接整个物流系统，生产建筑必须与道路向邻才能工作，道路放置时需要花费额外石头，花费量与距离总部的距离有关
en: The backbone of your logistics network. Production buildings must be adjacent to a Road to function. Building Roads costs extra Stone based on the distance from your Headquarters.

zh: 道路用来连接整个物流系统，生产建筑必须与道路向邻才能工作，道路放置时需要花费额外石头，花费量与距离总部的距离有关
en: The backbone of your logistics network. Production buildings must be adjacent to a Road to function. Building Roads costs extra Stone based on the distance from your Headquarters.

zh: 城堡每3回合生成1张骑士卡，骑士卡牌可以驱逐强盗和怪物地块。
en: A Castle. Generates 1 Knight Card every 3 turns. Knights can be used to clear Bandit and Monster tiles.

zh: 伐木营地每相邻一个森林地块，每回合木头产量+{adj_wood}
en: A Logging Camp. Wood production +{adj_wood} for each adjacent Forest tile.

zh: 总有些人会步入歧途，大人。这些强盗已经开始拦路劫掠了，而且他们正在向这里靠近，我们必须阻止他们
en: Some will always stray from the righteous path, My Lord. These bandits have begun pillaging our roads, and they are marching toward us. We must stop them.

zh: 最初只是一棵麦子开始变黑，但接下来整片麦田都开始枯萎了。我们不能让枯萎病继续扩散，必须摧毁感染的麦田，否则一切都完了
en: At first, it was just a single stalk of wheat turning black, but now entire fields are withering. We cannot let the blight spread. We must destroy the infected crops, or all is lost.

zh: 饥饿的灾民开始聚集在附近了，大人。我无意责怪你，我们无法控制粮食的收成，但我们必须拿出储备粮食，否则饥荒会摧毁我们所有的生产
en: Starving refugees are gathering nearby, My Lord. I mean no disrespect,we cannot control the harvests,but we must dip into our reserves, or the famine will bring all our production to a halt.

zh: 伐木工报告说林中的怪声越来越频繁了，最近开始有人失踪了，听说还有人发现了被撕碎的尸体。我们需要勇士去一探究竟
en: The woodcutters report that the strange noises in the woods are growing more frequent. People have gone missing recently, and rumor has it that mangled bodies were found. We need warriors to investigate.

zh: 我收到报告，采石场爆炸了，我尊敬的领主大人。被抛向空中的巨石砸毁了附近的道路，我们必须做些什么
en: I have received reports that the quarry has exploded, my honorable Lord. Massive boulders hurled into the air have crushed the nearby roads. We must take action.

zh: 王都那些人还以为我们挖到了金山。特使来了，大人，他带来了一份税务清单，我们必须按时上缴，否则国王可能会剥夺你的头衔
en: Those in the capital seem to think we've struck a mountain of gold. The royal envoy is here, My Lord, and he brings a tax manifest. We must pay it on time, or the King may strip you of your title.

zh: 领主大人，我明白你对海上的风暴并不陌生，但我依然要提醒你，现在的风暴将把这里变成一座孤岛，这段时间将不会有航船靠近我们的海岸了
en: My Lord, I know you are no stranger to storms at sea, but I must remind you of the consequences. This raging tempest will turn us into an isolated island,no ships will be able to approach our shores for the time being.

zh: 随机一个道路地块被强盗占据，被占据的地块将阻断道路连接，且该地块每回合向总部移动一格，当地块到达总部，游戏失败。该地块可以使用骑士卡恢复。
en: A random Road is occupied. It breaks road connectivity and moves 1 tile toward the HQ every turn. Reaching the HQ triggers Game Over. Use a Knight Card to restore.

zh: 随机一个麦田地块被感染，被感染的地块无法工作，且每回合会感染周围的所有麦田地块，被感染的地块可以被拆除。
en: A random Wheat Field is infected. Production is halted and it infects adjacent Wheat Fields every turn. Infected tiles can be DEMOLISHED.

zh: 交付食物阻止饥荒的发生，或是承受饥荒，承受饥荒意味着接下来的2回合内，所有生产建筑无法工作，但依然需要消耗食物。
en: Deliver Food to prevent or suffer the famine. Suffer Famine: All production is halted for 2 turns, but Food maintenance is still required.

zh: 随机一个森林地块变为怪物巢穴，该地块会使周围所有生产建筑无法工作，可以使用骑士卡恢复。
en: A random Forest becomes a Monster Nest. Production of adjacent tiles is halted. Use a Knight Card to restore.

zh: 一座采石场变为废墟，废墟无法生产资源，且会让周围的道路被阻塞。废墟可以通过改造地块恢复原状。
en: A Quarry collapses into Ruins. Production is halted and adjacent Roads are blocked. UPGRADE this tile to restore.

zh: 国王的使者需要在5回合内收取资源，当资源足够时，可以通过左上角的按钮交付，如果未能按时交付，则游戏失败。
en: Deliver required resources within 5 turns via the top-left menu. Failure triggers Game Over.

zh: 在3回合内无法通过交易界面换取资源。
贸易被封锁 剩余回合:
[center]%s\n当前感染麦田: [color=red]%d[/color] 块\n[font_size=12](需拆除阻断传染)[/font_size][/center]
[center]%s\n当前怪物巢穴: [color=red]%d[/color] 个\n[font_size=12](需派遣骑士驱逐)[/font_size][/center]
[center]%s\n距大本营: [color=red]%d[/color] 步\n[font_size=12](需派遣骑士拦截)[/font_size][/center]

[center]探险家协会
从零开始扩张与建设。

游戏目标：使用道路连接所有灯塔，重新点亮岛屿。
en:
[center]Explorer's Guild
Expand and build from the ground up.

Objective: Connect all Lighthouses using Roads to relight the island.

zh: [center]德鲁伊结社\n找回属于自己的遗产。
骑士卡可用来驱逐怪物和强盗地块
en: Knights can be used to banish monsters and bandits

zh: 这里是基础资源，用于建造建筑地块和生产其他资源，大部分建筑地块每回合需要消耗食物进行维护。
en: Basic Resources. Used to construct buildings and produce other resources. Most buildings require Food maintenance every turn.

zh: 探险家资源可用于在下方的探索按钮抽取自然地块。
en: Explorers. Spend them in the Explore menu below to draw natural tiles.

zh: 这里是玩家拥有的卡牌，可主动使用。
en: Your Cards. Click to use them during your turn.

zh: 建造按钮，可以消耗资源购买建筑地块，取消建造可返还资源。
en: Build. Spend resources to purchase building tiles. Canceling refunds the cost.

zh: 交易按钮，每回合可消耗交易点数以物换物。交易点数每回合刷新。
en: Trade. Spend Trade Points to exchange resources. Trade Points refresh every turn.

zh: 探索按钮，消耗1探险家资源，随机抽取自然地块，不选择地块不会返还探险家资源。
en: Explore. Spend 1 Explorer to draw natural tiles. Explorers are NOT refunded if you cancel or discard.

zh: 暂停菜单按钮。也可以查看游戏目标
en: Pause Menu,you can also view game objectives here.

zh: 这个界面会显示当前回合和距离下个随机事件的回合数。当随机事件出现时，玩家必须选择一个事件。正在进行的事件会出现在画面左上角。
en: Event Tracker. Shows the current Turn and turns remaining until the next Event. When an Event occurs, you must choose one. Active Events are displayed in the top-left.

zh: 右键点击一个地块，会显示其详细信息，以及改造和拆除选项。大部分自然地块都可以改造成资源生产地块。玩家每回合只能拆除2个地块。
en: Right-click a Tile to view details and Upgrade and Demolish options. Most natural tiles can be upgraded into production buildings. Max 2 Demolishes per Turn.

zh: 使用道路连接所有灯塔，重新点亮岛屿
en: Connect all Lighthouses using Roads to relight the island.
